title: CAT OS Lexicon bundle, schema v1
description: One bundle of reference vocabulary: every word of one frequency band (high / medium / low — the owner's reference lists 1, 2 and 3 in 99_REFERENCE/) whose first letter is `letter`. Generated by tools/build-lexicon.mjs; `word`, `meaning`, `synonyms` and `antonyms` are transcribed faithfully from the owner-supplied source, never invented or paraphrased (whitespace normalised, words lower-cased unless they carry an acronym-style capital, a trailing period stripped from list items only). Entry ids are sequential in source order within the bundle, so they are stable for as long as the source is unchanged; the same word listed twice in the source is two entries. This is the raw reference layer the gardens can look words up in; teaching layers (Language Garden plants, Word DNA units) keep referencing vocab-NNNN ids.

band.description: Frequency band of the source list: 1 - High, 2 - Medium, 3 - Low.

letter.description: First letter of every word in the bundle (diacritics ignored); "other" collects words that do not start with a letter.

file.description: Source file name(s) in 99_REFERENCE/, '; '-separated when a letter spans two files.

meaning.description: As written in the source (trimmed). Where the source continues a meaning on further lines — '(ii) …', 'b) …' — those lines are appended verbatim.
